text: B-STRONG features an integrated approach combining infrastructure repair with long-term resilience measures, such as climate-proofing roads and bridges and upgrading forecasting systems. It includes the construction of 79 multipurpose flood shelters that double as primary schools, ensuring year-round community value. The project emphasizes gender-responsive components, supporting women's homestead and community gardening, and aims to protect 1.6 million people through its initiatives.

metadata.solution_name: Bangladesh Sustainable Recovery, Emergency Preparedness and Response Project (B-STRONG)
